en.headline: Police arrest three more men over Tsim Sha Tsui bar murder
en.dek: A 40-year-old man was arrested for murder and two others for assisting offenders in connection with the 26 July attack that left a 32-year-old man dead.
body: Police have arrested three more local men in connection with the murder of a 32-year-old man who died after an attack at an upstairs bar in Tsim Sha Tsui on 26 July.

Officers arrested a 40-year-old man for murder and two men aged 36 and 52 for assisting offenders between 31 July and 1 August in Tsim Sha Tsui and Yuen Long. The Regional Anti-triad Unit of Kowloon West is continuing active inquiries.
The 36-year-old man will face a holding charge of assisting offenders at Kowloon City Magistrates’ Courts on Monday morning. The other two remain in detention for further enquiries.

Police earlier arrested six men and three women aged between 24 and 46. Three men have already been charged with murder and two with assisting offenders; the remaining arrestees were released on bail pending further investigation.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀酒吧謀殺案再拘三人 包括一名謀殺嫌疑
zh.dek: 警方就7月26日尖沙咀樓上酒吧襲擊致死案再拘捕三名本地男子，其中40歲男子涉嫌謀殺，另外兩人涉嫌協助罪犯。
body: 警方就7月26日尖沙咀一間樓上酒吧襲擊導致一名32歲男子死亡的謀殺案，再拘捕三名本地男子。
警方於7月31日至8月1日期間，在尖沙咀及元朗拘捕一名40歲男子涉嫌謀殺，以及兩名分別36歲及52歲男子涉嫌協助罪犯。九龍西總區反黑組正繼續積極調查。
36歲男子將於周一早上在九龍城裁判法院以協助罪犯罪名暫控；其餘兩人仍被扣留協助調查。
警方早前已拘捕六男三女，年齡介乎24至46歲。其中三名男子已暫控謀殺罪、兩名男子暫控協助罪犯，其餘被捕人士則獲准保釋，須於8月底向警方報到。
